_meta.purpose: Registry of school attendance-boundary (catchment) data sources per Ontario board. Drives scripts/admin/harvest-school-catchments.mjs (Tier A). Each verified source was confirmed 2026-06-15 with a live ArcGIS REST returnCountOnly query over a token-free endpoint. Kept in scripts/admin/ because data/ is regenerated by an external ETL.

statusLegend.verified_open: Queryable ArcGIS FeatureServer/MapServer polygon layer, no token, live count confirmed. Loadable via /query?where=1=1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson.
statusLegend.found_locked: Polygon service exists but requires a token / is hidden from the anonymous directory.
statusLegend.fallback: No openly queryable polygons (address-lookup tool, PDF maps, proprietary API, or non-commercial static file). Use the 2.5 km proximity-circle fallback.
statusLegend.harvestable_keyed: Boundaries exist behind a non-ArcGIS proprietary API that can be harvested per-school but has no open license.

_meta.harvestNotes: Field schemas are heterogeneous per board. panelMode='field' => one service split by panelField values; 'layer' => one layer per panel; 'fixed' => whole service is one panel; 'none' => combined (not panel-split). School names must be fuzzy-joined to data/ontario-schools.json to attach EQAO scores (no shared id).
_meta.licenseWarning: MOST sources carry NO explicit open-data license — merely shared 'public' in a board ArcGIS Online org. Commercial reuse is legally ambiguous; confirm terms/attribution per board. Exceptions: Region of Waterloo = OGL-style; Windsor (GECDSB/WECDSB) Borealis files = CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (NON-COMMERCIAL — excluded).

boardsTested.OCSB: 96/96 parsed, 0 null geom, 95 Polygon + 1 MultiPolygon, CATEGORY split Elementary 77 / Secondary 19.
boardsTested.YRDSB: 689 parsed BUT 226 have geometry:null (holding zones, ED_LEVEL=null). Real = 368 elem + 95 sec = 463.

harvesterMustHandle: Drop rows where geometry is null AND/OR the panel discriminator is null (holding zones).
Use the per-board panelMode mapping — never infer panel from a generic 'Type' field.
Paginate with resultOffset if a count exceeds maxRecordCount (seen as low as 1000).
Request outSR=4326 explicitly — native SRs vary (UTM 26918, WebMercator 3857).
